name: Gujju Express Logistics
subtitle: International Courier & WhatsApp Lead Generation
challenge: Generate relevant international courier enquiries from Surat customers looking to send parcels, documents, gifts and personal shipments overseas.
approach: International shipping video creatives with Gujarati creator hooks
Gujarati influencer-led shipping and unboxing content
Destination-specific UK shipping creatives with transparent rates
WhatsApp as the primary enquiry destination
Static and video creative performance testing
result: Generated 727 Meta-reported WhatsApp conversations at an average cost of ₹35.92, reaching 230,550 people across Surat with ₹26,112.18 total spend.

strategies.title: 01 LOCALISED SURAT GEO-TARGETING
strategies.description: Geo-fenced campaign delivery across Surat, Navsari, and key NRI family residential clusters, reaching households with family, relatives, and trade ties in the UK, USA, and overseas.

strategies.title: 02 GUJARATI INFLUENCER REEL COLLABORATIONS
strategies.description: Partnered with regional Gujarati creators to showcase real doorstep pickup, luggage packing tips, and seamless parcel unboxing, building immediate local credibility.

strategies.title: 03 DESTINATION-SPECIFIC UK SHIPPING CREATIVES
strategies.description: Created transparent Surat-to-UK price point graphics highlighting competitive kilogram rates, express transit times, and door-to-door courier guarantees.

strategies.title: 04 GUJARATI & ENGLISH BILINGUAL CREATIVE VARIATIONS
strategies.description: Tested authentic Gujarati headlines ('સુરત થી લંડન પાર્સલ મોકલો સરળતાથી') alongside English copy to appeal to both elder family decision-makers and modern students.

strategies.title: 05 DIRECT WHATSAPP CONVERSATION FUNNEL
strategies.description: Configured Meta Click-to-WhatsApp messaging ads with automated introductory greeting prompts, reducing inquiry friction down to zero clicks compared to website forms.

strategies.title: 06 STATIC VS VIDEO CREATIVE PERFORMANCE TESTING
strategies.description: Analyzed segment-level performance to discover that video delivered raw volume (314 conversations) while international static delivered peak cost efficiency (₹21.56 per conversation).

timeline.title: SURAT NRI CLUSTER MAPPING
timeline.description: Pincode geo-fencing across Surat's dense NRI diaspora belts, identifying peak overseas dispatch corridors.

timeline.title: CREATIVE FORMAT MATRIX
timeline.description: Scripting creator-led unboxing video reels and designing high-contrast UK rate cards.

timeline.title: WHATSAPP API INTEGRATION
timeline.description: Deploying 1-click WhatsApp messaging destinations with automated inquiry greetings for instant replies.

timeline.title: SEGMENT TESTING
timeline.description: Running concurrent ad sets across Video, UK Static, and International Static to observe CPA differentials.

timeline.title: BUDGET REALLOCATION
timeline.description: Scaling the ultra-efficient International Static creative (₹21.56/result) while keeping Video active for brand discovery.

timeline.title: FULL REPORT AUDIT
timeline.description: Auditing 727 verified conversations across ₹26,112.18 spend with 230,550 unique local reach.

keyLearnings: Video generated the highest conversation volume: 314 WhatsApp conversations powered by relatable Gujarati influencer hooks.
International static creatives achieved the lowest cost per conversation: ₹21.56 each (vs ₹34.77 for video), delivering maximum budget efficiency.
UK static generated 201 conversations at ₹52.85, proving strong intent for route-specific pricing despite higher CPA.
The overall campaign averaged ₹35.92 per conversation across 727 total verified conversations, reaching 230,550 people in Surat.
Direct WhatsApp messaging eliminated form-fill friction, fitting local customer communication preferences perfectly.
